Business Requirements Description:
This system is designed for managing work items, with the following core functionalities:
Stores the Attributes for each work item, including Attributes name, Attributes value, and link status.
Records the work item’s ID, name, description, creation date, update date, and other relevant information.
Tracks the link status of work items, which can be used to record the current status or related information about the work item.
ddl:
--Schemafordatabase:rschema_0356
--Foreachtable:

CREATE TABLE `work_items` (
  `work_item_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `creation_date` datetime NOT NULL,
  `update_date` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`work_item_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `attributes` (
  `attribute_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `work_item_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `attribute_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `attribute_value` text,
  PRIMARY KEY (`attribute_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`work_item_id`) REFERENCES `work_items` (`work_item_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `link_status` (
  `link_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `work_item_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`link_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`work_item_id`) REFERENCES `work_items` (`work_item_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
